blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The City of Manila on Thursday announced that it had acquired eight adjoining properties along C.M. Recto Avenue from the Land Bank of the Philippines worth P975 million, which will serve as the permanent site of Universidad de Manila (UdM). Manila Mayor Francisco “Isko Moreno” Domagoso said the property was originally valued at P2.3 billion before the city negotiated it down through financial engineering.
